changes: New MODE on the SETUP page: AM, USB or LSB.
In USB and LSB, TUNE mistunes a single-sideband receiver: the whole station moves up or down by 0 to 500 Hz, the 'Donald Duck' voice. No whistle there; DRFT makes the shift wander.
DRIV moved to the SETUP slot beside MODE: set DRIV again in a project saved with 0.1.0.
Not yet tested on a unit or in the emulator.
New: SHORTWAVE, the track as a distant station on a shortwave receiver, on FX1 or FX2.
Random fading with static that rises as it fades, crackle bursts and a beat whistle (TUNE) that can drift.
BAND sets the receiver's bandwidth (300 Hz to 4 kHz) and DRIV overloads it; MIX 0 is the dry, untouched.
Needs the Modwerk base loaded over USB (beta). Not yet tested on a unit or in the emulator.
